ns2:section.sectionText: Course Description: Provides a fundamental understanding of how accounting facilitates and influences decisions made by owners, managers, and employees within an organization. Accounting provides information for all types of decisions, ranging from everyday operational and procedural decisions to decisions about the long-term strategy and direction of the firm. Course topics include pricing, product selection, resource planning and allocation, and operational and strategic performance measurement. This course is intended for non-business majors. Students cannot receive credit for this course and ACCY 200, 201, and/or 202. This course has additional ID verification fees of $148 with Coursera.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for College of Business. Not intended for Business minor(s).
